## 3. PRIVACY RISK ASSESSMENT

### 3.1 Legal Basis Assessment

**Primary Legal Basis:**
- [ ] Consent
- [ ] Contract
- [ ] Legal Obligation
- [ ] Vital Interests
- [ ] Public Task
- [ ] Legitimate Interests

**Justification:**
[Explain why this legal basis applies]

**GDPR Article 6 Compliance:** [ ] Yes [ ] No [ ] N/A  
**GDPR Article 9 Compliance (if applicable):** [ ] Yes [ ] No [ ] N/A

### 3.2 Privacy Risks Identification

**Risk Assessment Methodology:**
- Likelihood: Low (1) | Medium (2) | High (3)
- Impact: Low (1) | Medium (2) | High (3) | Critical (4)
- Risk Score = Likelihood × Impact

#### Risk Register

| Risk ID | Risk Description | Category | Likelihood | Impact | Risk Score | Priority |
|---------|------------------|----------|------------|--------|------------|----------|
| R-001 | Unauthorized access to personal data | Confidentiality | | | | |
| R-002 | Data breach/loss | Confidentiality | | | | |
| R-003 | Excessive data collection | Proportionality | | | | |
| R-004 | Inadequate consent | Lawfulness | | | | |
| R-005 | Non-compliance with retention | Storage limitation | | | | |
| R-006 | Failure to support data subject rights | Individual rights | | | | |
| R-007 | Inadequate transparency | Transparency | | | | |
| R-008 | Function creep / Purpose change | Purpose limitation | | | | |
| R-009 | Third-party processor non-compliance | Accountability | | | | |
| R-010 | Inadequate international transfer safeguards | Transfer | | | | |
| [Add more as needed] | | | | | | |

## HOW TO USE THIS TEMPLATE

1. **Read** the entire template to understand all sections
2. **Customize** the template to your organization's specific needs
3. **Complete** all sections thoroughly - do not leave blanks without justification
4. **Consult** with stakeholders throughout the process
5. **Review** with DPO and legal before finalization
6. **Update** the PIA whenever there are significant changes
7. **Store** securely as it contains sensitive information about data processing

**Questions or Support:**
Contact your organization's Data Protection Officer or Privacy Team.
